extraction_warnings: This paper spans multiple distinct human cohorts (a single healthy male donor, individual RA treatment-naive donors used for gnotobiotic colonization, 30 MTX-naive ex vivo RA patients, and a 23-patient/17-patient longitudinal NYU RA cohort) as well as extensive mouse and in vitro isolate experiments; the schema fields were populated primarily from the NYU longitudinal RA patient cohort description, which is most human-subject-metadata-rich in the main text.

Detailed subject-level demographic data (age, sex, ancestry, exact sample IDs) are referenced as being in Supplementary Tables S1A/S1B/S1C, which were not provided in the given text, so many required fields are 'not_reported'.

DNA extraction kits and sequencing platforms differed between assay types (16S-seq vs shotgun metagenomics) and between mouse vs human samples; only the values pertaining to the human NYU RA cohort's primary 16S-seq were extracted, with conflicts noted.

The case/control classification is ambiguous because the same NYU RA cohort is split into MTX-responder (MTX-R) and non-responder (MTX-NR) subgroups rather than compared against explicit healthy controls in this dataset; 'Case' was inferred as all subjects have RA.
Country was inferred from institutional affiliation (NYU, USA) rather than explicitly stated as a country name in the text.

This paper primarily reports methodological/mechanistic microbiome data; detailed patient demographic tables (e.g., Table S1A, S1C) referenced but not provided in the text, limiting extraction of many schema fields.
Mouse age/sex data (C57BL/6J females, 6-16 weeks) exist but were excluded from human age fields since schema appears intended for human participant metadata.
antibiotics_current_use and dietary_restriction were inferred from exclusion criteria rather than directly stated participant status; treat with caution.
fmt_role/fmt_id extracted based on human stool donors used for gnotobiotic mouse colonization/FMT experiments; recipient role pertains to mice, not extracted here.
Oncology-specific fields (RECIST, ORR, PFS, tumor staging) are not applicable to this rheumatoid arthritis/microbiome study and were marked not_reported.
Many schema fields (zygosity, BMI, HLA, neonatal/obgyn fields, smoker) have no corresponding data in this paper.

The schema fields (biomarker_name/value/unit, disease_response_os, ecog_performance_status, tumor_size fields) appear oriented toward oncology/clinical trial studies and are largely not applicable to this microbiome/RA mechanistic paper; most were marked not_reported.

host_species is ambiguous because the study includes both human RA patients/donors and C57BL/6J mice as experimental hosts; 'human' was chosen as the primary participant species based on clinical cohort data, but mouse data are extensive and could also be considered under a different interpretation of 'participant'.
No single verbatim statement explicitly declares 'Homo sapiens' or 'human' as a formal species field; inference made from contextual descriptions of human donors and RA patients.
No per-sample rows from the article's own tables; falling back to the SRA/ENA run manifest (1 table(s)).
